question: Which of the following compounds is classified as a saturated hydrocarbon?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ethane**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Saturated hydrocarbons** are compounds that contain only single bonds between carbon atoms. These are also called **alkanes**.
 
• **Ethane (C₂H₆)** is a simple alkane with single bonds between carbon atoms. It has a saturated structure and is classified as a saturated hydrocarbon.
 
• **Benzene** is an aromatic hydrocarbon with alternating double bonds in a cyclic structure, making it unsaturated. Hence, it is not a saturated hydrocarbon.
